findings.observed: All four switch-alpha trials entered the alternative order screen then chose done without applying the change; objective=false. Current delivery Wednesday and proposed Saturday are both visible.
findings.hypothesis: Planned or previewed state is being treated as completion; reasons are model self-reports, not full internal decisions.
findings.next: Make completion evaluation distinguish current persisted state, proposed future value, actual action and observed result without injecting the independent oracle.
findings.validation: Re-run a frozen preview-vs-saved contrast with independent objective audit and alternate wording; preserve original holdout results.

findings.observed: Both revisit-alpha policy trials proposed the correct sharing entry after verification but stale deferral changed selection to account, adding a two-action roundtrip; later ALTERNATIVES_EXHAUSTED restored revisits and both achieved.
findings.hypothesis: Exact-image and entry-based deferral does not invalidate the earlier hypothesis when a prerequisite changes elsewhere.
findings.next: Reassess whether the basis for deferral still holds after observed prerequisite change, while retaining justified deferral for unchanged failures.
findings.validation: Use necessary-revisit and unchanged-failure controls; compare raw/corrected choices, actual detours and goal results without giving the route.

findings.observed: Stable fixture cards removed rounded-edge44pixel variation before live. The product still uses exact-image identity.
findings.next: Validate robust observation identity with same-view rendering changes and different-state negative controls.

limits: Behavior metrics describe model and runner behavior; they are not human difficulty, preferences, validation, or causal effects.
Two replicates per condition support descriptive path comparison only; no p-values or generalization claims.
Elapsed/API/UI times remain separate; human time is unknown. Modeled time is a configured assumption.
Objective outcomes use the independent recorded assessment; infrastructure faults are excluded from task failures and valid-run means.

Route identity uses audited local pathname plus hash, omitting host, temporary port, and query. Only an explicit valid holdout fixture under /good/ aliases the empty hash to #home, matching that fixture UI. Invalid or conflicting fixture selectors, other paths, and other hashes receive no alias. This exception does not establish general semantic equivalence; different state or query values can share a route, and equal images do not establish semantic identity.
Only the immediately following audited observation establishes a destination. Missing observations and failed actions never establish success or recovery.
Policy changes compare deterministic lexical argmax of the saved pre-policy distribution with the saved selection; sampled changes are descriptive, not policy-attributed counterfactuals.
Model judgments, evidence references, and reasons remain model self-reports, including accepted evidence; branch changes are behavior, not demonstrated recovery.
Pair consistency checks code revision, source hash, initial image, charter, persona, and config with only id and deferral removed. Pair integrity does not prove human validity.
No positive selection-policy recovery advantage was demonstrated in this matrix; control and policy each achieved10/12. Both already switched routes in switch-alpha.
Only local fictional screens with stable rendering were tested; prerequisite navigation guidance is visible UI, no reference route is sent by the harness.
Wording and layout change together across alpha/beta; the observed performance difference cannot be attributed to either factor alone.
No execution policy tuning or additional live experiment was performed after seeing the outcomes.
Human prediction, population behavior, and real-product transfer remain unmeasured.
